method: Unicode-normalized fuzzy catalog matching across assets/sources.txt, with VLC-verified fallback replacement from assets/failed-sources.txt; low-confidence matches withheld.

transport_sample.method: HTTP first-byte sample with an 8-second per-channel timeout; not a playback or identity verification.

probe_sample.method: Same-catalog alias match followed by bounded VLC playback profile with a 2-second run; no visible identity verification.

stream_url_policy: URLs are retained from the matched catalog exactly as supplied. VLC playback verification is recorded where available; no visible stream identity verification is claimed.
logo_policy: Logo bytes were fetched from each supplied tvg-logo URL and checked into logo/ under stable local filenames.

repository_profile.language_policy: Chinese-labelled channels use Chinese; other labels use English.
repository_profile.source_provenance: assets/sources.txt with VLC-verified fallback replacements from assets/failed-sources.txt

matching_summary.method: Unicode NFKC + punctuation/space normalization; exact and safe quality-suffix matches first; conservative difflib fuzzy candidates withheld unless unambiguous.
